Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 disp_format_mask varchar2(50);
begin
 if :Global.Error_count ='N' then 
 :Global.Error_count:='Y';
 if error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50025,50026,0) then
 if upper(substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),1,2)) ='FX' then
 disp_format_mask:=substr(get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK),3);
 else
 disp_format_mask:= get_item_property(:system.cursor_item, FORMAT_MASK);
 end if;
 disp_format_mask := translate(disp_format_mask, 'R', 'Y');
 show_error('0022',disp_format_mask);
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) then -- invalid time
 show_error('5016');
 end if;
 else
 null;
 end if; 
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 p_rea_id varchar2(10);
begin
 /*IF :GLOBAL.user_testing_lab_code != '99' 
 and :system.record_status in ('QUERY','CHANGED')
 THEN
 show_error('1180');
 END IF;*/
 IF :reagent_code is null or 
 :supplier_code is null or 
 :lot_number is null or 
 :reagent_type is null or
 :received_date is null or 
 :expiry_date is null or 
 :min_storage_temp is null or 
 :max_storage_temp is null or 
 :no_of_tests is null or 
 :visual_qc_flag is null or 
 :package_insert_date is null or 
 (:min_storage_temp > :max_storage_temp) or 
 :no_of_tests < 0 
 then
 show_error('2311');
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 begin
 if :package_insert_date > sysdate 
 then
 show_error('2303');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 if :visual_qc_flag = 'Y' and :reject_reason_code IS NOT NULL
 then 
 show_error('2327');
 go_item('visual_qc_flag');
 else
 :reagent_store_mst.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id;
 :reagent_store_mst.test_id :=:ctrl_block_1.s_test_id;
 execute_trigger('validate_record');
 check_package_failure;
 begin
 if :reagent_store_mst.reagent_id is null 
 then
 begin
 select :reagent_type||to_char(reagent_seq.nextval)
 into :reagent_store_mst.reagent_id
 from dual;
 select to_char( reagent_seq.nextval) 
 into p_rea_id 
 from dual;
 :received_by := :banner.user_id;
 exception 
 when others then 
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 end;
 end if;
 if :prep_required='Y' and :status is null then
 :reagent_status:='R';
 elsif :prep_required='N'and :status is null then
 :reagent_status:='P';
 elsif :prep_required = 'I' then
 :reagent_status := 'R'; 
 elsif :status = 'HOLD' then
 :reagent_status := 'Hold';
 end if;
 :reagent_store_mst.chapter_id:=:global.chapter_id;
 IF :GLOBAL.SUPERVISOR = 'Y' THEN
 if :visual_qc_flag = 'Y' and :global.user_testing_lab_code != '99' 
 then
 :reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := :reagent_store_mst.no_of_tests;
 elsif :visual_qc_flag = 'N' and :global.user_testing_lab_code != '99' 
 then
 :reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := 0;
 elsif :visual_qc_flag = 'N' and :global.user_testing_lab_code = '99' 
 then
 :reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := 0;
 end if;
 ELSE
 if :visual_qc_flag = 'Y' and :global.user_testing_lab_code != '99' 
 then
 :reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := :reagent_store_mst.no_of_tests;
 elsif :visual_qc_flag = 'N' and :global.user_testing_lab_code != '99' 
 then
 :reagent_store_mst.remaining_tests := 0;
 end if;
 END IF; 
 IF :note_books.note_id is null and :note_books.note is not null THEN
 SELECT notebook_seq.nextval INTO :note_books.note_id 
 from dual;
 set_block_property('reagent_store_mst',update_allowed,property_true);
 :reagent_store_mst.note_id := :note_books.note_id;
 END IF;
 :reagent_store_mst.note_id := :note_books.note_id;
 :system.message_level := '5'; 
 commit;
 IF not form_success then
 :system.message_level := '0';
 go_block('reagent_store_mst');
 execute_trigger('KEY-CLRFRM');
 check_package_failure;
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure; 
 ELSE
 show_error('8010'); 
 bell;
 :system.message_level := '0';
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 END IF;
 end;
 end if;
 end;
 END IF;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_REAGENTS
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
if :reagent_code is not null then
 select reagent_name 
 into :reagent_name
 from valid_reagents 
 where test_id = :s_test_id 
 and reagent_code = :reagent_code;
end if;
if :supplier_code is not null then
 select supplier_name 
 into :supplier_name 
 from suppliers 
 where supplier_code = :supplier_code;
end if;
if :reagent_type is not null then
 select code_desc
 into :reagent_desc
 from master_codes 
 where code_type = 'RGTYP' 
 and code = :reagent_type;
end if;
if :reject_reason_code is not null then
 select code_desc
 into :reject_r_cd_description 
 from master_codes 
 where code_type = 'RGREJ' 
 and code = :reject_reason_code;
end if;
 if :container_id is not null then 
 select code_desc
 into :container_name 
 from master_codes 
 where code = :container_id 
 and code_type = 'CONT';
 end if;
 if :storage_location is not null then 
 select code_desc
 into :storage_loc_name 
 from master_codes 
 where code = :storage_location 
 and code_type = 'STRLC';
 end if;
 if :reagent_status = 'Hold' then
 :status := 'HOLD';
 end if;
end;

RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select reagent_code, reagent_name, control_flag from valid_reagents where nvl(term_date, sysdate+1)>sysdate and test_id = :ctrl_block_1.s_test_id and reagent_type = :reagent_type and preparation_flag in ('Y','N','I') order by 1 asc

RecordGroup.Name: CTRL_BLK_1_S_TEST_ID_LOV0
